data.long_meaning: The meaning of Michael is recorded in name-lists as “Who is like God?”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Michael expresses “Who is like God?”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Michael total 33, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: A rhetorical Hebrew name: mi, 'who', + ka, 'like', + El, 'God' — 'Who is like God?'. Its root is Hebrew m-y-k-ʾ-l. The archangel Michael (Daniel 10:13; Revelation 12:7). Michael is a Hebrew name meaning “Who is like God?”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
